assessment: At this clean source after the ordinary-text encoder fix, pooled small-unrelated preflight/assembly medians are 0.366937/1.366220 ms against unchanged 0.453/2.409 ms limits. Large-unrelated medians are 0.233674/0.902917 ms against unchanged 1.066/2.812 ms limits. Every original generation timing and structural budget passes. This artifact records generation measurements only; the separately running final aggregate is not presumed complete.

execution.sourceState: Three isolated generation test processes ran sequentially on clean e91f2438b after the encoder change in 9650d422c. No other worker tests, builds or research ran during timing.
execution.timingInstrumentation: No profiler or SQL/clone instrumentation runs inside the timing loops. Structural counters are collected separately and their spies are restored before timing.

retention: All three original generation report objects are retained unchanged, including runtime, architecture, CPU, all structural counters and all 216 timing values. Each dimension has one unrecorded warmup and three measured repetitions per process; no emitted sample is removed.

originalBudgetAssessment.method: Analytical comparison after execution. Vitest asserts semantics and structural work budgets; RISU_GENERATION_COST_TIMING=1 records timings without asserting millisecond limits. Each of three fresh processes performs one unrecorded warmup and three recorded repetitions for each of twelve dimensions. Original timing limits are compared against the pooled median of all nine retained measurements per metric/dimension. Individual samples and per-process medians remain visible; none were discarded.
originalBudgetAssessment.limitsSource: generation-baseline.md: original small-unrelated 0.453/2.409 ms and large-unrelated 1.066/2.812 ms limits. No new timing gate is assigned to required history, configuration-row parsing or named legacy embedded storage.

residualAxes.unrelatedNormalizedCorpus: Selected snapshots and read/clone counts remain bounded as unrelated normalized characters, chats, histories, presets, modules and assets grow. The original small and large timing gates apply to this axis.
residualAxes.requiredHistory: The 4/40/160 target-message dimensions retain necessary history reads, captured history and token/prompt work. Preflight reads zero message rows. Their pooled timings and structural sizes remain separate from unrelated-corpus acceptance.
residualAxes.configurationRow: The 0/12/48 unused configuration-record dimensions still expose growing settings-row JSON parsing even though selected snapshot and clone sizes remain stable. No new timing limit is invented for this residual.
residualAxes.legacyEmbedded: The named 0/12/48 legacy embedded-character dimensions still read a larger settings row and capture additional configuration. All raw costs and pooled medians remain explicit; this storage compatibility residual is not silently included in ordinary selected-read limits.
